entry.name: usageCache
entry.label: Redacted last-known quota cache for the current configuration.

entry.name: commandPath
entry.label: Path to the codexbar command.

entry.name: refreshOnOpen
entry.label: Refresh quota data when opening the popup.

entry.name: privacyMode
entry.label: Hide personal information in the widget.

entry.name: showPopupPace
entry.label: Show pace forecasts in the popup.

entry.name: showPopupCredits
entry.label: Show credits and extra usage in the popup.

entry.name: showPopupProviderDetails
entry.label: Show provider detail rows and charts in the popup.

entry.name: refreshInterval
entry.label: Refresh interval in seconds.

entry.name: includeStatus
entry.label: Fetch provider service status.

entry.name: usageBarsShowUsed
entry.label: Show usage bars as percent used instead of percent left.

entry.name: showQuotaWarningMarkers
entry.label: Show quota warning indicators on usage meters.

entry.name: quotaWarningPercent
entry.label: Used percent that raises a quota warning.

entry.name: quotaCriticalPercent
entry.label: Used percent that raises a critical quota warning.

entry.name: enableNotifications
entry.label: Enable Plasma notifications.

entry.name: notifyStatusIncidents
entry.label: Notify when provider status incidents appear or change.

entry.name: notifyQuotaWarnings
entry.label: Notify when usage crosses quota warning thresholds.

entry.name: notifyPredictivePaceWarnings
entry.label: Notify when CLI pace data predicts quota exhaustion before reset.

entry.name: notifyLimitResets
entry.label: Notify when a heavily used limit resets back to empty.

entry.name: cliAutomaticUpdates
entry.label: Automatically update the selected widget-managed CLI daily.

entry.name: menuBarDisplayMode
entry.label: Panel text display mode.

entry.name: showPopupTabLabels
entry.label: Show text labels in the popup tab bar.

entry.name: providerOrder
entry.label: Ordered provider identifiers used by the widget.

entry.name: resetTimesShowAbsolute
entry.label: Show reset times as absolute local times.

entry.name: showProviderIconsInPanel
entry.label: Show each provider's logo beside its panel meter.

entry.name: panelThickness
entry.label: Measured panel thickness in pixels, written by the widget so the settings preview matches.

entry.name: panelMeterScale
entry.label: Indicator size as a share of the panel thickness (0.5 to 1).

entry.name: panelMeterStyle
entry.label: Panel meter shape: bars or rings.

entry.name: showPercentInPanel
entry.label: Show the selected usage text in the panel.

entry.name: showMultiProviderInPanel
entry.label: Show provider meters in the panel.

entry.name: panelQuotaLane
entry.label: Panel quota: auto shows primary and secondary meters with automatic text; explicit lanes show one quota.

entry.name: panelProviderIDs
entry.label: Comma-separated provider ids shown in the panel; empty shows every enabled provider.

entry.name: autoSelectProvider
entry.label: Auto-select the highest-usage provider.

entry.name: overviewProviderIDs
entry.label: Comma-separated provider ids shown in the Overview tab.

entry.name: showCreditsInPanel
entry.label: Show credits in the panel when available.

entry.name: providerDetectionCache
entry.label: Last provider detection result with its timestamp, so the Providers page opens without rescanning.

entry.name: providerSettingsFocus
entry.label: Provider the popup asked the settings dialog to open on; cleared once used.

entry.name: providerConfigRevision
entry.label: Internal revision bumped when provider enablement changes.
